content:
GOAL: fix the binding design constraint for this round from the rounds-1/2 measurements, before choosing a mechanism.
READ: the task brief only (no repo access, no shell): r1 curved residual chain -> test_recall@10 0.05439 with L3 prefix count 2201; r2 concentration-scaled geodesic step toward popularity-adjusted successor barycentre -> 0.05165 with L3 prefix count 1298 (99.1% of items moved, median displacement 0.0207); frozen baseline ~0.0679; gate 0.065. Constraints (a) tree claim unavailable (degree-preserving rewiring equally tree-like), (b) curvature is a gauge, behaviour-contrast predicts recall (+0.7104 plain, +0.7170 Euclidean control) while Gromov-delta weighting (-0.12) and ancestor-depth weighting (-0.075) hurt and radial term is compactness not hierarchy, (c) any objective minimised at the ball origin collapses the encoder, (d) behaviour must reach the TOKENS not just codebook positions.
OBSERVED: the only quantity that tracks the recall gap across the two negative rounds is deep prefix capacity (2201 vs 1298); both mechanisms MERGED prefixes (hub attraction, saturated 3-level 256-codebook) and both lost.
REASONING: therefore any viable candidate must strictly ADD deep prefix capacity and must place behaviour where it refines rather than aggregates. Attraction-style codeword/item movement is empirically the wrong sign; per-level curvature control and radial/entropy ranking are already taken by earlier rounds (CURVCTRL-SID, BRad-RQ, poincare-frechet-successor-codebook) and must not be restated. A low-risk construction is a composite deep-level alphabet: keep the 256-way parent partition (so no cell can ever merge) and expand only the level-3 symbol set, with the expansion direction chosen by a behaviour quantity and the expansion geometry defined by an explicit curved bisector.
STILL OPEN: exact operator, derivation of every constant, per-step cost at 24556 items / 24 steps / 3000 epochs.

GOAL: anti-collision check against the five earlier proposals and selection of the final mechanism.
READ: the prior-round list in the brief (poincare-frechet-successor-codebook: successor-weighted Frechet codebook updates; CURVCTRL-SID: per-level curvature set by hard prefix-transition score; LORENTZ-SUCCPROFILE-SMOOTH-RQ; behcone-prefix-rq; succboost-geoshift; BRad-RQ: behaviour-ranked radial Poincare assignment by context entropy; BRANCHCURV-MOEB-RQ; TSG-SID) plus the round-two concentration-scaled geodesic step.
REJECTED AS OVERLAP: (i) successor/Karcher-mean codeword updates = poincare-frechet-successor-codebook and r2 attraction, both merge prefixes; (ii) per-level curvature as a function of prefix-transition score = CURVCTRL-SID; (iii) radial coordinate ranked by behaviour entropy = BRad-RQ (and radial term is compactness, not hierarchy); (iv) appending a 4th SID token: legal but changes the frozen Stage-3 sequence length and adds a per-position generation step, an avoidable risk; (v) free 512/1024-codeword level 3: capacity only, no behaviour-geometry coupling, fails scope contract item 3.
CHOSEN: BGSQ-SID. Level 3 becomes a composite 4*k + side alphabet (256 parents x 4 sides = 1024 symbols), the 4 sides being the quadrants of the top-2 BEHAVIOUR-WEIGHTED second-moment directions of the level-3 residual, with w_i = JS(p_i || pbar_k)/ln2 (bounded, no scale constant), axes and offsets computed ONCE from the train transition matrix and a deterministic initial RQ forward pass, frozen during the 3000 epochs, and the side test implemented as a geodesic hyperplane through the trained parent codeword in the Poincare ball (c=1): sign of <log_0((ominus c_k) + v^(2)), u>. Children sit at c_k + exp_0(+-s u). Removing behaviour sets w=1; removing curvature sends c to 0 (Euclidean +, exp/log = identity). No objective has its minimum at the origin: M_k is a second moment whose maximiser is on the sphere and s_k is a measured median, so the round-one collapse mode is structurally excluded.
COST CHECK: parameters added = 0 (u,s are buffers, ~0.3M floats); per-step overhead = 2 dot products of dim d per item plus one Mobius add and one exp_0 per item, ~+2-4%; one-off precompute (sparse JS, 2201 small eigenproblems) minutes on one GPU. Distinct-triple ceiling rises from 2201 toward 4x (~7-9k), each current L3 prefix holding ~11 items, so collision relief is the predicted route to the gain.
STILL OPEN: nothing blocking; final block written next.

FINAL ANSWER (BGSQ-SID), one mechanism, in the required plain-text block. Summary of the argument a reviewer can check: (1) capacity: level-3 alphabet 256 -> 1024 by composite 4*k+side, no parent cell removed, so no merging, and 2201 observed distinct triples hold ~11 items each today, so collision relief is the measured-consistent lever; (2) behaviour reaches tokens: the side bits are signs of the item's residual along axes whose second moment is weighted by JS(p_i||pbar_k), so item->token changes if behaviour changes; (3) curvature is functional not decorative: the side test is a geodesic hyperplane through the trained parent codeword (sign of <log_0((ominus c_k) plus v^(2)), u>), children at c_k plus exp_0(+-s u), and the tanh saturation of exp_0 makes the tangent-to-ball volume of a fixed +-s offset depend on the cell's radius, i.e. dense central cells get the finest effective refinement, which a Euclidean control (c->0) does not do; (4) no tuning: w in [0,1] by JS/ln2, s = median |<t,u>| floored at 1e-3*median||t||, axes = eigenvectors of a measured matrix, one precompute, one run; (5) collapse-proof: nothing is optimised toward the origin. Predicted observables recorded in the block: distinct (l1,l2,l3) triples, full-SID collision rate, realised between-side JS of successor distributions, and Stage-3 test_recall@10.

STAGE: constraint analysis before the third-round idea. No filesystem; evidence is the round brief.

GOAL: pick a coupling position still open, and rule out ones that are provably empty.

OBSERVED: frozen 3-level RQ-VAE, 256 codes/level, 24556 items, 24 steps/epoch, batch 4096, 3000 epochs, 0.145-0.16 s/epoch. Round1 prefixes 251/1769/2201, recall 0.05439. Round2 geodesic move of 99.1% items (median disp 0.0207) gave prefixes 230/1251/1298 and recall 0.05165. Behaviour-contrast predicts recall (+0.7104); Gromov-delta and ancestor-depth weighting hurt. Rejected already: successor-Frechet codebooks, per-level curvature from prefix-transition score, Lorentz successor profile smoothing, behaviour cones, entropy-ranked radial assignment, MOEB branch curvature, TSG-SID.

DERIVED FINDING (reusable): on a Poincare ball d_c is a monotone transform of ball-scaled Euclidean distance, and ball isometries (Mobius translation, tangent rescaling) preserve nearest-anchor argmin. Hence any single-anchor curved nearest-neighbour assignment and any per-level or per-item curvature scalar is curvature-gauge-invariant: it cannot move tokens once c is fixed. That structurally explains why per-level curvature control cannot work. A curved op can reach tokens only via (i) a weighted SUM of two or more artanh terms at separated anchors, (ii) geodesic midpoints/Frechet means used as sites, or (iii) mixing with a Euclidean piece (residual addition, decoder MSE, straight-through).

SECOND FINDING: 2201 distinct L3 triples for 24556 items is ~1.24 L3 codes per L2 cell, so the deepest frozen level is nearly redundant; more codewords in one global L3 table buys little. The lever is more DISTINCT DEEP CELLS per L2 cell, i.e. a per-parent product digit, which also cannot repeat round two's merge failure because no input point moves.

DECISION: propose a per-level-3-cell 4-symbol fourth digit, child prototypes = hyperbolic Frechet centroids of directed-transition ASYMMETRY quantiles (forward successor row vs backward predecessor column, JSD, support-shrunk), assignment by argmin of d_c(xi,u_kj) + b_i*d_c(xi,v_kj). Uses (i), multiplies deep cells ~4x, avoids successor barycentres, entropy ranking, radial rank, per-level curvature, cones, residual smoothing.

OPEN: is asymmetry dense enough (items with <5 transitions fall back to a default and children degrade to text quartiles); does a 4th token lengthen Stage-3 generation enough to offset the finer SID. Both recorded as risks; policy forbids extra arms.

STAGE: design check of BISECT-L4-ASYM against the five scope criteria.

1 BEHAVIOUR: directed transition asymmetry b_i = s_i*JSD(p_succ(i,.),p_pred(i,.))/log2, s_i=n_i/(n_i+5), from training sessions only, computed once pre-Stage2. PASS.
2 GEOMETRY: Poincare ball, c=(1/(1.2R))^2 from measured initial latent radius R; Mobius addition, d_c, 5-step Frechet centroid; acts in the level-4 child prototypes and both distance terms of the level-4 assignment. PASS.
3 COUPLING: one path b_i -> asymmetry quantiles of the cell -> frozen hyperbolic centroids v_kj -> two-anchor score -> l4 -> SID -> Stage-3 token. Removing b changes both anchors and the weight; removing the curve changes centroid construction and both distances. The two-term sum is non-gauge by the earlier finding, so geometry is not decorative. PASS.
4 TESTABLE: observables are distinct 4-token SID count (expect >=6000 from ~2201), per-cell child entropy, child-vs-quantile correlation, position-4 prefix-conditioned accuracy, Stage-3 test_recall@10 vs 0.065 and vs 0.05439/0.05165. Three switches defined (behaviour off = b=0.5 plus text quartiles; geometry off = Euclidean distances/means; both on = full) but only both-on is trained. PASS.
5 MINIMAL SPEC: offline counts, quantile split, Frechet fixed point, assignment equation, straight-through quantized vector, one-time prototype freeze at end of epoch 1, deterministic dead-child reseed at epochs 10/30/100/300 (fixed fractions of 3000). Cost: 1024 trainable + 1024 frozen child vectors (d=64, ~131k params, <1% encoder); per step 4096*4*2=32768 Poincare distances at d=64 (~4M FLOP, <3% of encoder); <= +0.004 s/epoch => <= +12 s over 3000 epochs; one-off pass O(N log N) over 24556 items. PASS.

FAILURE-MODE CHECK against constraint (c): the objective has no minimum at the ball origin - nothing is pulled toward 0; children are born at quantile centroids of the actual cell, and a dead-child reseed plus per-cell entropy logging makes the round-one collapse visible. Target direction is finer, not merged: deep cells multiply per parent instead of points being displaced.

LEAKAGE: F, b, quantile groups and frozen prototypes from training items/sequences only; valid/test items get digits by the same frozen argmin using only frozen tables; no test statistic sets c, the smoothing prior or the child count.

STILL OPEN: sparsity of asymmetry; extra Stage-3 generation step. Both are risks, not gates.

STAGE: final answer delivered in chat as BISECT-L4-ASYM (full field values in the reply; two design records already saved as records 6 and 7). Core: per-cell 4-symbol fourth SID digit, child prototypes = hyperbolic Frechet centroids of directed-transition-asymmetry quantiles of each level-3 cell, assignment = argmin_j [d_c(xi,u_kj) + b_i*d_c(xi,v_kj)]; switches: behaviour-off (b=0.5, text quartiles), geometry-off (Euclidean), both-on. Expected +1024 child vectors, 32768 Poincare distances per step, <=+0.004 s/epoch. Open risks: asymmetry sparsity and the extra Stage-3 generation step.
